postToolUse.bash: IN=$(cat); ROOT=$(printf '%s' "$IN" | jq -r '.cwd // empty' 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$ROOT" ] && ROOT=$(pwd); SCRIPT="$ROOT/tools/context-insight-visualizer/hooks/record-subagent.js"; [ -f "$SCRIPT" ] && printf '%s' "$IN" | node "$SCRIPT"; exit 0
postToolUse.powershell: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$in=[Console]::In.ReadToEnd(); $root=$null; try { $j=$in|ConvertFrom-Json; if($j.cwd){$root=$j.cwd} } catch {}; if(-not $root){$root=(Get-Location).Path}; $p=Join-Path $root 'tools/context-insight-visualizer/hooks/record-subagent.js'; if(Test-Path $p){$in | node $p}"
